cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. I put it in the right drawer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Filed, then. I'll reconcile it against this quote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Estimate filed; purchase order requested. I'm getting fluent in accounts already.

mechanism: A performs accounts fluency by absorbing its former pupil terminology corrections as evidence of the organizational habits A taught.
confusable: Not simply knowing the jargon or asking to learn it: A confidently misuses, revises, and immediately reuses each corrected term while retaining mentor status.
comparison: Former filing tutor entering accounts versus former speaking tutor joining pupil club.
